audience: HR, payroll and benefits teams at employers connected to Finch

useCases.title: Review job titles, departments and employment status
useCases.text: List the employees in the company directory. Then read the job title, department, start and end dates, status and manager of the people you choose.

useCases.title: Review payroll totals for recent pay dates
useCases.text: List the payments whose pay date falls in a period. Then read each pay statement for gross pay, net pay, taxes and deductions.

useCases.title: See who is enrolled in a 401k or HSA deduction
useCases.text: List the company deductions and contributions. Then see who is enrolled in one of them, with the employee and company amounts.

useCases.title: Map pay groups and their pay frequencies
useCases.text: List the pay groups with their pay frequencies. Then read one group to see the ids of the people in it.

useCases.title: Confirm the Finch connection and company profile
useCases.text: Show the Finch connection, its products and its entity ids. Then read the company profile with departments and locations, and list the payroll and HR providers Finch supports.

useCases.title: Read W-4 tax withholding forms (beta)
useCases.text: List the W-4 tax withholding forms that Finch supports, then open one document by its id. The Finch document endpoints are in beta and may change.
